scripts.pages:prepare: npm run inject-env && npm run build:standalone && node scripts/prepare-pages.mjs
scripts.print:test-plan: pandoc MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md -o MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.html --standalone --metadata title='Manual Test Plan' --css=scripts/print.css && open MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.html
scripts.print:test-plan:pdf: pandoc MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md -o MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.pdf --pdf-engine=xelatex -V geometry:margin=2cm -V mainfont='PingFang TC' -V CJKmainfont='PingFang TC' && open MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.pdf
